en.topic_title: Taiwan hails late Hong Kong bookseller for ‘resistance’ against China
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong bookseller who fled to Taiwan in 2019 after being detained by China was hailed for his “resistance and defiance” at a memorial service on Friday.



Mourners leave messages on a wall during the funeral of Hong Kong bookseller Lam Wing-kee in Taipei on July 31, 2026. Photo: Cheng Yu-chen/AFP.



Lam Wing-kee, 70, died in Taipei on July 2 after a battle with cancer.
